newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 26.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 26.

text.p: * Silicon Graphics Inc said after the market close on Wednesday that its fiscal first quarter earnings will be "substantially below" Wall Street expectations. Its shares closed off 1/2 at 23-5/8.
* Abercrombie & Fitch is coming to market this morning. Shares of the retailer, which outfitted the expeditions of Teddy Roosevelt and Ernest Hemingway, priced at $16 for the initial public offering.
* Johnson Controls Inc said it plans a joint venture with a Beijing-based automotive parts maker as part of a broader plan to expand into Asia. It closed off 1/8 to 75-3/8.
* EG&G Inc said it expects earnings for the year to fall short of expectations. The company projects earnings of $1.15 to $1.20 a share, versus expectations of $1.30. It closed off 1/4 to 20-1/2.
* Three-Five Systems Inc said it expects a third quarter loss of $0.60 to $0.70 a share, with 80 percent of the loss due to inventory reserves. It rose 3/4 to 13 on the New York Stock Exchange.
* Starter Corp expects third quarter earnings and revenues to be similar to or slightly below results in the year-ago period due to a change in retailer order patterns. Starter fell 1/8 to 6-3/4.
